idle.description: Relaxed right-handed hold with the weapon base between the right shoulder and pectoral; barrel crosses northwest toward the actor's left.

aimed.description: North-facing aim midway between actor center and right shoulder, extended forward.

walk.description: Keep both feet fully occluded at rest. Briefly interpolate one foot to its tip-reveal offset while the other remains hidden, then alternate.

runtimeAnimation.recoil: From the aimed pose, translate the rifle briefly backward along its local axis and return it to aimed.offset.
runtimeAnimation.fire: Show muzzleFlash at rifle.muzzle for the desired flash duration.
